text.p: Portuguese cash bonds and futures rose and dealers said prices could go higher but that 10-year maturities were keeping a close eye on Bunds.

"Longer U.S. bonds really took off yesterday and that has pushed the Bund higher. The longer end is where all the interest is. Prices could rise further today but it really depends on Germany," said one dealer.
Traders said the 70 basis-point yield differential with 10-year Bunds was likely to remain.
The escudo was steady at 100.89 per mark and traders said it would stay in a range between 100.80 and 101.0 per mark.
